00077 #define EVENT_CHAINBANKFUNCTION_DOCS     You must implement this virtual function in your subclass.      \
00078               The parent Bank or Chain UGen calls this function multiple times to    \
00079               create an array of UGen instances to use in a chain or bank structure.   \
00080               @param input  If this is used in a Bank UGen this will be the    \
00081                    input to the Bank and all events get the same input.  \
00082                    If this is used in a Chain UGen the first link (when  \
00083                    eventCount is 0) will get the input to the chain but  \
00084                    subsequent links will get the output of the previous  \
00085                    link as their input.          \
00086               @param eventCount The index of the event instance starting at 0 for   \
00087                    the first event.           \
00088               @return    The UGen graph for this event instance.

00114 template <class ChainLinkType, class OwnerType>
00115 class ChainUGenInternal : public ChainBaseUGenInternal
00116 {
00117 public:
00118  ChainUGenInternal(UGen const& input, const int size, const int numChannels, OwnerType* o) throw()
00119  : ChainBaseUGenInternal(input, size, numChannels), chainLinkCreator(o)
00120  { 
00121   ugen_assert(size > 0);
00122   init(input, size);
00123  }
00124  
00125  ChainUGenInternal(UGen const& input, const int size, const int numChannels, ChainLinkType const& e) throw()
00126  : ChainBaseUGenInternal(input, size, numChannels), chainLinkCreator(e)
00127  { 
00128   ugen_assert(size > 0);
00129   init(input, size);
00130  }
00131 
00132 private:
00133  void init(UGen const& input, const int size)
00134  {
00135   UGen nextInput = input;
00136   for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00137   {
00138    nextInput = chainLinkCreator.createEvent(nextInput, i);
00139    chain.put(i, nextInput);
00140   }
00141  }
00142  
00143 protected:
00144  ChainLinkType chainLinkCreator;
00145 };
00146
